ground_truth_protocol.description: OPC UA binary protocol over TCP 4840: UA TCP message header, then the secure-conversation headers and the encoded service request/response whose node id selects the message type. Encrypted message bodies are one bytes field. Derived from the Wireshark/tshark dissection of the benchmark capture (dol/truth-file-derivation/scripts/build_truth.py): fields at a fixed offset in at least 60% of a type's messages, bitfields sharing a byte merged, arrays of 3+ equal fields and variable-position content kept as one bytes field (the modbus.json convention for register arrays); types with fewer than 5 messages are omitted.
ground_truth_protocol.offset_convention: Message header fields use wire-absolute offsets 0..7; the other types are relative to offset 8.

message_types.name: UA TCP message header
message_types.description: Three-byte ASCII message type (HEL, ACK, ERR, OPN, CLO, MSG), chunk type and message size. Offsets are wire-absolute.
